name: fashioncart-root
description: Root orchestration for FashionCart Microservices Stack

scripts.install-backend: npm install --prefix backend/auth-service && npm install --prefix backend/product-service && npm install --prefix backend/order-service
scripts.install-all: npm run install-root && npm run install-backend
scripts.start-all: npx concurrently "npm run start-gateway" "npm run start-auth" "npm run start-product" "npm run start-order"
